title: PROJECT V — Replay Kinematics (derived, Layer-B)
description: Aggregate movement statistics derived from ONE decoded VALORANT .vrf replay by tools/replay-parser/analysis. Calibration input for the simulation/combat engines. AGGREGATES ONLY — no per-frame trajectory, no ProfileName, no raw .vrf. All speeds are reported in BOTH uu/s and m/s (1 uu ≈ 1 cm; unitsPerMeter=100). Angles in degrees, yaw rate in deg/s, times in ms unless a field says seconds.

provenance.description: Mirrors datasets/schema/provenance.schema.json. evidenceType=derived (computed from decoded positions). synthetic MUST be false for real captures.

capture.description: What replay this came from. players use anonymous player_N ids only.

decodedHint.description: Map folder decoded from the parser class-path (primary signal).

transformRanking.description: valorant-api transform [0,1]-containment test per candidate map (corroborating, weak for small samples).

projection.description: Result of applying the identified map's valorant-api transform (axis-swapped: minimapX=gameY*xMul+xAdd, minimapY=gameX*yMul+yAdd) to all sample positions.

fractionInUnit.description: Fraction of samples landing in minimap [0,1]; 1.0 = transform fully valid for this capture.

callouts.description: Nearest PV-4 callout-zone assignment (game-world distance). Ascent only. Zone anchor positions are PV-4 'manual-approx'.

kinematics.description: Core movement statistics. Every block carries its sample n. See tools/replay-parser/analysis/kinematics.mjs for definitions.

config.description: sampleHz (128), unitsPerMeter (100), thresholdsMps (idle/walk/run band edges) + thresholdBasis.

speed.description: Step-speed distribution. percentilesUU/Mps, topSpeed, meanMovingMps, and stateFractions (idle/walkOrCrouch/run/anomalous by speed band).

yawRate.description: Facing angular velocity (deg/s). percentiles + mean. Combat-engine input for turn/aim-adjust timing.

acceleration.description: Per move-segment accel/decel proxies in seconds (start->peak, peak->end) + segment peak-speed percentiles.

firstMove.description: Time from round start to first moving step (ms). n, values[], meanMs. Sparse unless round starts are provided.
